skill_name: Compare and contrast the benefits of online education and traditional education.
workflow: Online education and traditional education both offer unique benefits. Traditional education tends to create more of a structured learning environment with classes that meet in physical spaces and have a more intimate connection between professors and students. Online education on the other hand allows students more flexibility with course schedules and a more individualized approach to learning with the ability to focus on topics of interest.
